text: ECO-0142 is released. PN-31010 moved from Rev B to Rev C.
Thanks, checking the harness notes against the motor bay routing.
Schedule sync: PN-51010 T1 is on 2026-10-14, and G-DVT1 is on 2026-10-22.
DOC-11020-CM Rev B issued to Sunrise for PN-11020.
Thanks, I’ll treat Rev B as the CM pack for Sunrise.
EVT-2 exit review decision: G-EVT2-EXIT is passed with actions. DEV-0007 is expired as of today.
Thanks <@U0EM01>. I’ll keep the schedule status as green-with-actions and track owners in the program log.
Got it. I’ll close out the DEV-0007 references from the EE side so we don’t keep carrying that exception.
ME actions are noted. Nothing blocking the exit from our side.
FW is aligned. Send me any action wording you want mirrored in the test notes.
Morning from Sunrise. Quick one on the drive module sub-assy: what torque for the M5 SHCS into the 6061 bracket? Drawing just says "per spec" and our spec sheet has two values (5.2 and 6.0)
<@U0CM01> 6.0 N-m with blue threadlocker. 5.2 is the old dry value, ignore it. It's note 7 on the assy drawing, sorry that's buried
perfect, thanks Nadia. updating our traveler
PLM release: PN-11020 Rev C is now active. Change moves the Orin carrier standoff hole pattern.
Got it. <@U0SC01> the CM drawing pack that went out yesterday was PN-11020 Rev B, so Sunrise needs the Rev C packet before cutting anything.
Thanks. I'll check the Orin carrier clearance against PN-11020 Rev C and flag if the moved standoffs hit anything.
Copy. I'll ask Sunrise to pause on PN-11020 Rev B and confirm receipt of PN-11020 Rev C.
Heads up: the six EVT spare compute units are on PN-42011, and that carrier is LTB passed / NCNR for any new PO.
Thanks <@U0SC01>. Do we have enough already on hand to cover the EVT spares, or is this blocking the build plan?
Not calling it blocked yet. I’m checking allocation and will flag if the spare pool needs a different path.
EE note: Xavier carrier and CTI carrier are the same PN-42011 here, so please keep the PO line tied to the PN and not just the nickname.
Got it. Please tag me if the NCNR exposure changes the EVT spare count or timing.
FYI TST-THM-02 is run 1 marginal on the motor driver. I'm going to rerun it with the new vent layout before we call the thermal review done.
Thanks <@U0EE01>. Ping me before the rerun and I'll make sure the FW logging config is clean.
<@U0EE01> went through the OS0 point clouds from SN004 and SN007. the bumper fascia clips the bottom ~4 deg of the lidar FOV at the front corners. raising the mount would clear it
yeah saw the same thing in the dock-approach logs, floor returns drop out right at the corners. how much do you need? the lidar cable has maybe 10mm of service loop before I'd want a new length
+8 clears it with some margin. ok going w/ +8, I'll update the drawing
works for me, 8 is fine on the harness side. no new cable length needed
Heads up: I placed PO-45002211 for 50x PN-31010 Rev B. Reposting the Monday PLM note here too: ECO-0142 moved PN-31010 from Rev B to Rev C.
Yep, PN-31010 should now be Rev C after ECO-0142. Rev B on the harness PO is the mismatch.
Thanks for catching it, <@U0SC01>. Can we pause release against PO-45002211 until the rev is corrected?
I’ll contact the supplier and ask to update PO-45002211 from Rev B to Rev C. Not treating it as clear-to-build until they confirm.
Please keep the qty at 50 when you revise it. I’ll note the risk on the build tracker.
Blocker: TST-EMC-01 is failing the pre-scan by about 6 dB at 150 MHz on PN-31010. The fix needs PN-31010 Rev D.
Got it. Is the noise tied to motor PWM edges, or does it stay there with the drive disabled?
Only shows up with the motor phases active. The current PN-31010 routing is acting like the radiator.
If PN-31010 Rev D is the blocker, I can help check clip clearance once you have the harness layout change.
Thanks. Please keep this on the release risk list until PN-31010 Rev D is built and TST-EMC-01 passes.
Cross-posting the schedule sync note from Monday: PN-51010 T1 was showing 2026-10-14, with G-DVT1 on 2026-10-22. The molder has now moved top cover PN-51010 T1 to 2026-10-21 for slider rework.
Thanks <@U0CM01>. So PN-51010 gate date is now 2026-10-21, correct?
Correct. 2026-10-21 is the date we have from the molder.
Got it. Please keep the slider rework notes with the top cover record so we can check what changed when samples land.
I’ll update the open schedule line for PN-51010 T1 and flag the slip in the next sync.
Anyone know if the 3D printer queue is real-time? I’m seeing my small bracket behind three jobs that all say “almost done.”
It’s real-time-ish. One of those jobs needs support cleanup before the next one starts, so add a little slack.
If nobody objects, I’m bumping my enclosure spacer to tonight. Not blocking anything.
Also lunch run in 15. Drop orders here or walk with us.
<@U0FW01> when are we rerunning TST-SAF-01 on the DVT firmware? I need the latest slot for tracking.
DVT-1 machining status: PN-11051 lidar bracket rev A, qty 40, on the Haas today, should finish Fri. PN-11034 drive bracket done 40/40. <@U0SC01> pls confirm the anodize PO when you're online
<@U0CM01> anodize PO goes out this morning, I'll drop the number in here
Blocker on PN-21030: C-MLCC-100V is now in allocation with no ship date. The Samsung alternate the broker offered is not on the AML.
Ugh. Please don’t buy the Samsung part yet; if it’s not on AML I need to check the derating and footprint before we touch it.
<@U0EE01> can you sanity check today whether the 1210s have any qualified drop-in? <@U0SC01> please keep the hold on PN-21030 clear-to-build until we know.
Yep, I’ll mark PN-21030 blocked on that line item and ask distribution for any AML stock on the 100V MLCC.
FA-0031 has corrective action identified: PN-11034 moves to Rev C with the keyed shaft interface. Heads up that we already have 40 PN-11034 Rev B brackets machined.
Thanks <@U0ME01>. Please tag the 40 as hold until we decide rework vs scrap.
I’ll block those 40 from the build pull. If Rev C needs a fresh PO, send me the updated print when it’s released.
No EE concern from the keyed shaft change. Just need confirmation the bracket envelope stays the same.
Envelope stays the same. I’ll attach the PN-11034 Rev C print once doc control pushes it.
DHL just updated the PN-43010 safety scanner shipment; it’s in transit now.
Good, thanks <@U0SC01>. Please keep an eye on the next scan before we plan around it.
Nice. Once they land, EE can do receiving inspection on the nanoScan units.
Reposting the DHL note from earlier: the SICK scanners still show the same tracking update as this morning.
Thanks <@U0SC01>. Sounds like no new info, just keeping it visible here.
Yep, noted. No program action from this unless DHL moves again.
<@U0EM01> pilot customer is pushing again for 600 kg payload. I’m worried this turns into a PRD churn risk if we let it in now.
Agree. We should keep the PRD at 500 kg through DVT-1 and treat 600 kg as a post-DVT-1 evaluation item.
Works for me. I’ll message it as: no PRD change before DVT-1, but we’ll capture the customer ask and revisit with data.
<@U0SC01> quick check: was PO-45002211 amended to Rev C? I need to line up the EE AVL note with the PO rev.
FAI photos + CMM for PN-11020 came back with the Rev B hole pattern. Looks like Sunrise is building chassis base from a stale drawing pack. <@U0ME01> can you sanity check the standoff locations?
That's not what we want after the PLM update earlier this week. <@U0CM01> can you hold FAI signoff until the pack is checked?
Yes, holding signoff and pausing any more chassis base runs until document control confirms what Sunrise has.
Confirmed from the photos: the Orin carrier standoff holes match PN-11020 Rev B. Please send Sunrise the PN-11020 Rev C print and have them re-program before cutting more.
I'll log the supply risk and ask for the corrected first-article ETA once the current pack is in their hands.
For PN-90001, the pilot customer is pushing us to size around the heavier tote case, not the current PRD payload. No PRD edit and no decision from this thread yet.
Got it. That likely touches lift margin and wheel loading, so I’d keep it as a spec delta until we run the checks.
EE impact depends on duty cycle and accel limits. Please don’t let this become the default ask without a signed change.
FW can gate it behind a config if needed, but I agree it should not silently replace the baseline.
Yep. I’ll log it as pilot-only input for now and keep PN-90001 aligned to the current approved PRD until we review.
Top cover logo review is somehow still open. I’m saying the current font looks too soft once it’s embossed, and the depth feels like it will catch grime.
I don’t care about the exact font as much as making sure it reads cleanly after texture. If the mark looks fuzzy on first articles, we’ll be annoyed forever.
Please don’t make the emboss proud enough to become a wipe snag. The cover already gets handled a lot during service.
That’s why I’m pushing shallower with a simpler face. The fancy font is doing us zero favors in molded plastic.
From the FW side I have no stake in the font, but if this delays the top cover drawing release I’m voting for boring and readable.
Let’s stop bikeshedding it here. <@U0ME01> pick the plainest option that meets tooling feedback and note the emboss as shallow in the drawing comments.
Yes, PO-45002211 is amended to Rev C now. I’ll send the updated PDF to the supplier thread too.
G-DVT1 is on day 9 and we're 4 days into the 7-day buffer. TST-THM-02 is still open, and the top-cover DFM review is still open too.
I still owe the thermal review closeout. The rerun with the new vent layout is queued, and I'll post the readout as soon as it finishes.
Top-cover DFM is waiting on the snap detail feedback. I can pull that into the same closeout path so we do not burn another day.
Please keep the buffer view current today. If either review slips past close of day, I'll flag the G-DVT1 schedule risk in the status note.
Thanks. Let's treat TST-THM-02 and top-cover DFM as the only blockers for the next G-DVT1 call unless someone sees another one.
Blocker from the battery vendor: they cannot air-ship 40x PN-61001 Rev B. Their TST-UN383 summary only covers Rev A.
That matches what I have. PN-61001 Rev B is the current pack, but the UN 38.3 paperwork never got updated past Rev A.
Thanks <@U0SC01>. Are they offering ground freight as a fallback, or is everything held until the updated summary exists?
Ground is allowed, air shipment is blocked. I’m asking for their fastest ground option plus timing for a Rev B TST-UN383 summary.
Please post the ETA when they answer. If PN-61001 Rev B can’t fly this week, we’ll need to adjust the clear-to-build plan.
Blocker on the DVT-1 kit: I counted 32x PN-31020, so we’re short 8 signal harnesses.
Got it. I’ll check the packout record and carton photos for PN-31020 now.
Please hold those builds until we know if the missing signal harnesses are on site somewhere. I don’t want ad hoc cable swaps in DVT-1.
Agree. <@U0SC01> can you give an ETA for locate or replacement, and <@U0CM01> keep the shortage logged in the build sheet?
Yep, logging it as PN-31020 shortage with current count at 32. I’ll pause the affected units until we get direction.
Found the 8 PN-31020 in incoming QC. DVT-1 kit count is 40, false alarm on the short.
CM just flagged they want to use 30 leftover PN-51012 Rev A bumper fascias on DVT-1. Risk is DEV-0007 only covered EVT-2, and it expired at the exit review.
Agree, PN-51012 Rev A should not roll into DVT-1 under that deviation. Need either a fresh deviation or the Rev A stock stays out of the build.
I’ll tell CM to hold those 30 aside for now. Do we want me to ask for a clean count of non-Rev A fascia stock too?
Yes, get the count and keep the Rev A lot blocked. <@U0CM01> please open the action against DVT-1 build readiness so it doesn’t disappear in email.
Will do. Restating the earlier note here: DEV-0007 closed with EVT-2, so DVT-1 needs its own disposition before any PN-51012 Rev A parts go on units.
Holding G-TR1 for PN-51010. Texture release is on hold until the top-cover vent layout is confirmed.
Good call. Please keep the DFM review open so we do not release against a moving cover layout.
EE still needs to bless the vent layout after the rerun data. I will post back once the motor driver temps look acceptable.
Thanks <@U0EE01>. I will leave the PN-51010 texture notes unissued for now and just keep the package staged.
I changed the bumper-switch bracket to a stiffer geometry. The old one was flexing enough to tickle the switch on sharp floor seams.
Thanks <@U0ME01>. Any interface change for the bumper cover or same fasteners?
Same fasteners and same cover interface. I added ribs and opened the bend radius so the switch face stays put under side load.
From EE side, switch travel and connector clearance still look okay if the envelope stayed the same. Please flag me before release if the bracket edge moved near the harness.
Will do. I’ll send the print through mech review today and call out the rib clearance around the harness in the notes.
FW v0.9.3 is released. Main safety-chain change: e-stop debounce is now 20 ms, after what we saw on TST-SAF-01 with v0.9.1.
Thanks <@U0FW01>. I’ll check the EE notes for any impact on the e-stop input filtering assumptions.
Please tag any test plan updates against TST-SAF-01 so we don’t lose the reason for the bump.
Yep, I’ll update the release note and call out v0.9.3 as the baseline for the next safety-chain run.
Following up on yesterday's bracket note: FW is adding a bumper input filter on PN-21040. Spec param is 50 ms, in parallel with <@U0ME01>'s stiffer switch bracket fix.
Yep, ME fix is still moving. This shouldn't block the bracket update; it just gives us more margin on chatter.
Works for EE. Please keep it scoped to the bumper input only on PN-21040 so we don't mask any other safety IO edges.
Confirmed, bumper input only. I'll put it behind the existing safety IO config path and tag the FW release note.
Thanks. Add a quick bench log when it's in, and note that the mechanical bracket fix is still required.
Decision from today: G-DVT1 is a conditional GO. Open conditions are the thermal review and the battery ship plan.
Got it. I’ll track those two as gate conditions in the program notes.
I’ll own the thermal review inputs from EE. Need the latest run plots before we call it closed.
I’ll take the battery ship plan. I’ll confirm carrier constraints and packout timing.
Thanks. Please post updates here when each condition is ready for signoff.
Kicked off BLD-DVT1 this morning. First build log is up for the DVT-1 units.
Thanks <@U0CM01>. We'll use that as the build source of truth for DVT-1.
